🐺 Welcome to Wolves' Life Dawn! 🐺
Awooo! Welcome to the wonderful world of Wolves' Life!
Roam the beautiful world of Wolves' Life, and live out your wolf story.

🔔 IMPORTANT Notice: There are only a few developers of this game at the very moment, and we are working hard to ship out updates and bug fixes. 
Prioritized fixes are: Fixed animations(and more animations), console adaptation, customization

🎩 Customize your own personal wolf, any color, and accessories. 
🤝 Make friends and good memories
🛖 Claim your own wolf den!
☀️ Enjoy the different atmospheres

MAIN DEVELOPERS:
